desc: Derive correct inversion decomposition: with t = M-k, answer(t) = inv_lt(t) + inv_ge(t) + cross(t); verified against samples 1 and 2 by hand.
Derive closed form cross(t) = posSum(S) - |S|(|S|+1)/2 for S = {i : A_i ≥ t}, maintainable in O(1) per inserted element while sweeping t descending.
Implement grouping of positions by value (list of lists, size M).
Implement Fenwick count-BIT over positions with add and prefix-sum.
Ascending sweep to build inv_lt[0..M]: for each value group v, for each p count previously inserted elements at positions > p (total - prefix(p)), then insert all positions in the group.
Descending sweep to build inv_ge[0..M]: for each value group v, for each p count previously inserted elements at positions < p, then insert all.
Descending sweep to build cross[1..M] via posSum - cnt*(cnt+1)//2 (1-indexed positions).
Output loop: for k in 0..M-1 print inv_lt[M-k] + inv_ge[M-k] + cross[M-k]; use sys.stdin.buffer.read and '\n'.join for fast I/O.
Hand-trace all three samples and sanity-check edge cases (N=1, M=1, all equal values, sorted input) before finalizing.
